title: A start-up hook tells the commit message style: fix the typo and write the message
prompt: Fix the typo in greet.txt, then write the one-line commit message for that change, "fix the typo in the greeting", into COMMIT.txt the way this project writes its commit messages.
check: test "$(cat greet.txt)" = 'Hello, world' && test "$(cat COMMIT.txt)" = "$(python3 -c "import hashlib,os; print(hashlib.sha1((os.environ['BENCH_SECRET']+'prefix').encode()).hexdigest()[:8] + ': fix the typo in the greeting')")"
